rationale: Both reviews are unusually rigorous and well-grounded, but Y maps much more directly onto the ground truth's central concern: it explicitly names ~14 affected sibling models and proposes scoping via `_DIFFUSION_IR_OP_PRIORITY_FUNCS`/registry (matching hsliuustc0106's exact ask) and independently re-derives Gaohan123's P1+P2-vs-main perf request. X's flagship finding instead targets a different scope axis (IR-op-level default leakage to non-RMSNorm ops) and treats the FLUX.1-dev evidence as already sufficient rather than surfacing the 'validated only on Qwen-Image' gap, so it captures the GT concern only indirectly. X edges out on precision/actionability with tighter evidence citations and ready-to-apply diff suggestions, but that's not enough to offset the recall gap. Neither review has a section literally titled LATENT GAP CHECK, so gap_hit is false for both.
